data.body:
Implemented the certified plan; pushed as Gerrit change 1779 patch set 2 (WIP released, votes pending).

WHAT LANDED (4 files, 487+/15-):
- compact_txn.py: the fold now EXCLUDES fsck-orphans from retirement + source_event_uuids citation via _exclude_snapshot_orphans, anchored to the latest prior SNAPSHOT in the fold set; first fold (no prior snapshot) excludes nothing; unreadable anchor excludes nothing (fsck cannot classify against it either). Kept the defer guard (_defer_presnapshot_foldables): pre-snapshot foldables never fold while their governing snapshot is young. Dropped ALL absorbing/ordering machinery from PS1.
- fsck_repair.py: extracted the shared predicate is_snapshot_orphan (KNOWN type, non-snapshot, name < snapshot filename, uuid not in that snapshot's source_event_uuids) next to the routing sets, and added the routing-parity gate in repair_or_plan: any HUMAN_TRIAGE orphan on the ticket blocks the whole-ticket rebuild and emits a TRIAGE line (findings persist, rc stays 1).
- fsck_scan.py: _check_snapshot now consumes the shared predicate. DEVIATION NOTE: this is a 4th file beyond the recorded file_impact — required by the plan's "extract/reuse that predicate as a shared helper so fold and fsck cannot disagree"; a copy left inline in fsck_scan could drift. Diff is surgical (import + predicate call).
- tests/unit/test_fold_orphan_laundering.py: 9 tests, RED-first verified against origin/main (5 failed for the right reasons: orphan retired+cited+fsck-clean; repair-after-fold restores nothing; defer fold errored; --repair-snapshots rebuilt past STATUS orphans, alone and mixed). Covers: laundering exclusion, repair-window-survives-fold-then-repair-restores (integration AC), first-fold guard, healthy-refold guard, defer guard, cited-presnapshot-event-is-not-an-orphan, triage skip, mixed-orphan block, auto-recover still rebuilds.

MUTATION PASS: 6 mutants, 6 killed. M1 predicate comparison inverted (name< -> >): killed. M2 uuid-membership check dropped: SURVIVED initially — no test pinned that a cited-but-unretired folded source (SNAPSHOT_INCONSISTENT shape) still folds; added test_cited_presnapshot_event_is_not_an_orphan, M2 now killed. M3 first-fold guard removed: killed. M4 citation drawn from pre-exclusion set (cite-without-retire split): killed. M5 triage routing gate bypassed: killed. M6 defer guard neutered: killed.

VALIDATION: make lint green (complexity ratchet active=53 new=0 increased=0; the C901 hits on _repair_plan/_repair_run are frozen baseline entries, untouched). make typecheck green (539 files). Targeted suites: 119 passed (unit -k fsck/compact), 403 passed on the wider compact/fsck/fold/snapshot/orphan/repair selection. Pre-existing environmental failures excluded per operator note; the tests/integration/test_prepare_reclaim_backup.py + test_concurrency_regression.py fixture errors reproduce on merged main (git config rc 128), not caused by this change.

Out of scope, untouched per plan: doctor routing, writer-path auto-detection (G3), historical laundered-snapshot detection (trainsick-fleeting-avocet), --absorb-orphans (removed with the PS1 absorbing machinery).
